data.summary: The two reviews are old, generic, and represent the only online feedback for this contractor. The perfect 5.0 rating with only two reviews from 5 years ago is suspicious, especially given the lack of presence on other platforms. This pattern suggests either minimal real business activity or potential review manipulation from the early days of the business.
fake_signals: Very low review volume (2) for a 5-year-old business
Both reviews posted 5 years ago with no recent activity
Reviews are generic and lack specific project details
Both reviews have exactly 1 like, suggesting possible coordination
No presence on major contractor review platforms (Angi, Houzz, Yelp)
authentic_signals: Different author names and writing styles
Owner responses are polite and professional
One review mentions a referral from a friend
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google reviews are present, showing a perfect 5.0 rating. No other platforms have ratings to compare.
